title: V-SHARE: Provable Convergence Guarantees for Advantage-based Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2610.21448v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In reinforcement learning, advantage-based value-learning methods, unlike standard Q-learning, share information across actions by decomposing the action-value function into a state-dependent value component and action-specific advantages. While this mechanism has proven effective in both tabular and deep reinforcement learning, its theoretical understanding remains incomplete. We introduce V-SHARE, an advantage-based value-learning algorithm that combines cross-action value sharing with an importance-weighted Bellman-residual correction. To our knowledge, we provide the first complete theoretical characterization of an advantage-based algorithm, including both asymptotic convergence and non-asymptotic finite-sample guarantees. translated_title: V-SHARE：基于优势的算法的可证明收敛保证
translated_abstract: 在强化学习中，基于优势的价值学习方法与标准Q学习不同，它通过将动作价值函数分解为依赖于状态的价值分量和动作特定的优势分量，从而在动作之间共享信息。虽然这一机制在表格型和深度强化学习中都已被证明是有效的，但对其理论理解仍然不完整。我们提出了V-SHARE，这是一种基于优势的价值学习算法，它将跨动作价值共享与重要性加权的贝尔曼残差校正相结合。据我们所知，我们首次对基于优势的算法提供了完整的理论刻画，包括渐近收敛性和非渐近的有限样本保证。我们识别了一个适用范围，其中V-SHARE缓解了异步Q学习的稀有动作瓶颈，并揭示了更强的确定性收缩与增加的重要性加权方差之间的收缩-方差权衡。
tldr: 本文提出V-SHARE算法，首次为基于优势的价值学习方法提供了完整的理论收敛保证（包括渐近收敛和非渐近有限样本保证），并证明其能缓解异步Q学习的稀有动作瓶颈，同时揭示了收缩性与方差之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: V-SHARE is the first advantage-based value-learning algorithm with complete theoretical convergence guarantees (both asymptotic and finite-sample), mitigating the rare-action bottleneck of asynchronous Q-learning while revealing a contraction-variance tradeoff.
